label: Episode 12
logline: When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 11's cliffhanger where the Constable pulls Gerald's planted gold pocket watch from Alexander's trench coat.

picks.logline: When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.

picks.transcript:
CLIP: episode 12, 1 segment(s), 38s
[00:05.70-00:08.80] JULIANA (Furious, Defiant): "No! That watch was not in his coat!"
[00:09.10-00:11.80] CAMERA: Close-up of the Constable narrowing his eyes coldly at Juliana.
[00:10.00-00:11.70] CONSTABLE (Blunt, Unyielding): "I found it there myself."
[00:11.80-00:13.90] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana glaring back with unwavering conviction.
[00:12.30-00:13.90] JULIANA (Passionate, Accusatory): "Then someone put it there!"
[00:13.90-00:20.80] CAMERA: Medium full shot of Gerald framed in the open cottage doorway holding his riding crop, stepping inside with a patronizing, gloating grin.
[00:14.30-00:20.60] GERALD (Smug, Condescending): "The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket."
[00:20.80-00:23.70] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.
[00:21.60-00:23.60] ALEXANDER (Low, Steady, Dangerous): "I have never touched your property."
[00:23.70-00:26.90] CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.
[00:23.70-00:26.80] GERALD (Mocking, Malicious): "Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat."
[00:26.80-00:28.00] ACTION: Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.
[00:26.80-00:27.90] JULIANA (Enraged, Shouting): "You planted it!"
[00:28.00-00:29.80] CAMERA: Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.
[00:28.10-00:30.00] CLARISSA (Purring, Taunting): "Oh, dear sister..."
[00:29.80-00:31.00] CAMERA: Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.
[00:30.00-00:32.40] CLARISSA (Continuing taunt): "...still defending your broken scrap of a man?"
[00:31.00-00:32.40] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.
[00:32.40-00:35.30] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.
[00:32.40-00:35.20] JULIANA (Steely, Resolute): "Name your price, Clarissa. I know you."
[00:35.30-00:40.00] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.
[00:35.40-00:40.00] CLARISSA (Smooth, Derisive): "You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape."
[00:40.00-00:41.80] CAMERA: Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.
[00:40.10-00:41.50] CLARISSA (Scheming): "Perhaps I can give you one."
[00:41.80-00:43.70] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.
[00:42.20-00:43.50] JULIANA (Guarded, Cold): "What do you want?"
[00:43.70-00:43.75] CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.

[00:44.00-00:46.40] CLARISSA (Cruel, Savoring): "I want to see you crawl, sister."
[00:46.60-00:52.40] CAMERA: Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.
[00:46.70-00:52.30] CLARISSA (Theatrical, Vindictive): "My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."
[00:52.40-00:56.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.
[00:52.40-00:56.70] CLARISSA (Chilling, Sarcastic): "...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."
[00:56.80-00:58.00] ACTION: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
[00:56.80-01:00.80] CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.
[00:57.30-01:00.60] CLARISSA (Demanding, Brutal): "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."
[01:00.80-01:03.20] CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald tapping his whip against his palm and laughing heartily beside the Constable.
[01:00.80-01:03.10] GERALD (Gleeful, Derisive): "A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!"
[01:03.20-01:05.20] CAMERA: Medium three-shot of Clarissa stepping behind Juliana, as Alexander watches helplessly with dark fury.
[01:03.30-01:05.10] CLARISSA (Cold, Transactional): "Do it, and we withdraw the charges."
[01:05.20-01:09.45] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Clarissa's mouth leaning directly into Juliana's ear, whispering venomously.
[01:05.40-01:09.20] CLARISSA (Whispering, Menacing): "Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows."
